text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the race unfolding as planned, Satono 
Crown was confident of victory. However, 
Duramente hung on relentlessly with an 
astonishing late burst of speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown emerged victorious. However, 
she felt dread at Duramente's relentless 
surge from behind...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown struggled to truly feel the 
weight of her own victory. Duramente then 
approached, declaring their upcoming 
rematch at the Japanese Derby.
